chunks: Do not sit with those who drink wine, for when the curse descends, it encompasses whoever is in the gathering.

key_terms.اَللَّعْنَةَ: the divine curse or banishment from mercy
key_terms.تُجَالِسُوا: to sit or keep company with others in a gathering

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام forbid sitting with those who drink wine?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام forbids keeping company with those who drink wine. The hadith warns that divine punishment, when it descends upon a sinful gathering, may encompass all who are present there.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5090 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Do not sit with those who drink wine, for when the curse descends, it encompasses everyone present in the gathering."
